programme.desc: An exploration of the infamous expanse of the Atlantic Ocean. Measurements are made of the geological features on the ocean floor by draining the water. Sonar surveys show what lies beneath the surface.
programme.title: Drain the Bermuda Triangle

programme.desc: S11 E1 — Disaster Runway On 17 July 2007, TAM Airlines Flight 3054 slid off runway 35L at Congonhas Airport in São Paulo, Brazil, and crashed at high speed into a warehouse adjacent to a petrol station, killing nearly 200 people.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Call for Help Multiple 911 calls push Dawson City to the brink as they battle to save a family home and a historic building, while snowstorms pummel Whitehorse, causing chaos and forcing a dangerous backcountry helicopter rescue mission.

programme.desc: S6 E12 — Dead Fall The next generation of Alaskans risk it all to ensure their survival.
programme.title: Life Below Zero: Next Generation

programme.desc: S1 E9 — Satellites OneWeb Satellites reveal how space vehicle designers, manufacturing engineers and robotics combine to build and launch web satellites into space.
programme.title: Made in a Day

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Drugs, Guns and Money CBP finds drugs hidden in cans, and HSI stops a date rape drug from hitting the streets.
programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Club Drugs and Party People CBP MIA finds a package of ecstasy, which leads to a controlled delivery and arrest. CBP JFK questions a traveller connected to known drug smugglers.
programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler

programme.desc: Mint Chocolate & Chips A visit to a traditional Ohio candy factory reveals how melt-in-your-mouth chocolate mints are lovingly finished by hand, and the secret to making perfectly seasoned plantain chips is given away.
programme.title: Food Factory

programme.desc: Peanut Butter Cups & Butterscotch An insight into the production process of pound cake, and peanut butter cups with butterscotch. Plus, a visit to the factory that makes sauce for butter chicken, and see how a jelly of oranges, mandarins and limes is made.
programme.title: Food Factory

programme.desc: S1 E7 — The Little Rascal An orphaned pup is met with hostility on his search for a new family.
programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Homeward Bound A minor injury turns into big trouble for Champ when a predator closes in. Plus, Ponce fights for survival after getting lost in unfamiliar territory.
programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor

programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.
programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.desc: S19 E6 — Runway Runoff When a Continental Airlines flight crashes in Denver, all clues point to a mechanical problem. But then, investigators find the true culprit in the Rocky Mountains.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S19 E7 — Lethal Limits En route to Perm, Russia, Aeroflot Nord Flight 821 is on final approach when the plane crashes.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Columbia, Eschede Train, Grenfell Tower Three real world disasters dissected; in space, on a train, in a high-rise.
programme.title: Disaster Autopsy

programme.desc: S1 — Titan Missile, Estonia, Piper Alpha Three real world disasters dissected; nuclear missile, ferry, oil rig.
programme.title: Disaster Autopsy

programme.desc: S3 E4 — Tug O' War On the Turkish Mediterranean coast, Sanmar Shipyards is quietly reshaping the future of global shipping. Sanmar builds powerful tugboats on a large scale while simultaneously designing the next generation of vessels.
programme.title: Mega Marine Machines

programme.desc: S1 E9 — Chinook Discover the Chinook, the heavy-lift helicopter that rewrote the rules of aviation. Born in the 1950s America, the Chinook entered service in Vietnam. Its bent airframe and tandem rotors gave it a huge lift capability.
programme.title: Planes That Changed History

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Secret World of the Minotaur Archaeologists have found evidence that sheds light on the terrifying legend of King Minos and the dreaded Minotaur. Who were the mysterious Minoans, and where does this myth come from?
programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Secrets of the Acropolis In Athens, experts race to restore the Parthenon, while across the Mediterranean, archaeologists uncover the story of the civilization that built it.
programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Anne Boleyn Executed on charges of adultery and treason, Anne Boleyn is often remembered as the 'harlot'. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow explore evidence that reveals a different Anne, whose ideas transformed England and whose reputation deserves reassessing.
programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads

programme.desc: S11 E13 — Sioux City Fireball United Airlines Flight 232 is 37,000 feet over Iowa when one of its three engines explodes. It's up to investigators to figure out how a foolproof system failed.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S17 E2 — Deadly Myth A commuter flight to Detroit ends in a harrowing death spiral, and a close analysis leads investigators to a stunning realisation.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S18 E5 — Deadly Display On a high-stakes demonstration flight in Indonesia, a Russian-made Sukhoi Superjet slams into a mountain killing everyone on board. It's one of the most challenging salvage operations Indonesian investigators have ever faced.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.desc: S15 E7 — Deadly Delay When Spanair Flight 5022 crashes just seconds after taking off from Madrid, investigators suspect a last-minute repair may have played an unexpected role in the catastrophe.
programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Carthage: One City, Two Empires The Phoenicians built Carthage, a grand city at Mediterranean trade crossroads, in the 9th century BC. After the Third Punic War, Rome took over, leaving Hadrian with the responsibility to ensure year-round water supply.
programme.title: Ancient Megacities

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Promises After the turbulent years following World War II, fragile peace gives way to rising tensions between former allies. Truman and Stalin's decisions give rise to a rivalry that lasts for decades.
programme.title: Titans of the Cold War

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Helena Bonham Carter Helena explores the story of her maternal grandfather Eduardo Propper de Callejon. A Spanish diplomat, Eduardo defied his government's orders, and helped Jewish people escape the Holocaust as the Nazis invaded France. Helena learns that her paternal grandmother Lady Violet Bonham Carter also took her own stand against anti-Semitism. A mother of four and a liberal politician, Violet was ahead of her time, volunteering as an air raid warden and campaigning for women's rights.
programme.title: My Grandparents' War

programme.title: Lost World of Angkor Wat

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Mark Rylance Actor and peace campaigner Mark Rylance explores the extraordinary World War II story of his grandfather Osmond Skinner, who spent almost four years as a Japanese prisoner of war. Mark uncovers how Osmond, a banker for HSBC, bravely joined the Hong Kong Volunteer Defence Force with no military training and was thrown into a deadly battle to defend the island. Rylance's views on war are tested as he uncovers the real and shocking story of how Osmond survived Hong Kong's notorious POW camps.
programme.title: My Grandparents' War

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Helena Bonham Carter Helena explores the story of her maternal grandfather Eduardo Propper de Callejon. A Spanish diplomat, Eduardo defied his government's orders, and helped Jewish people escape the Holocaust as the Nazis invaded France. Helena learns that her paternal grandmother Lady Violet Bonham Carter also took her own stand against anti-Semitism. A mother of four and a liberal politician, Violet was ahead of her time, volunteering as an air raid warden and campaigning for women's rights.
programme.title: My Grandparents' War

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Mark Rylance Actor and peace campaigner Mark Rylance explores the extraordinary World War II story of his grandfather Osmond Skinner, who spent almost four years as a Japanese prisoner of war. Mark uncovers how Osmond, a banker for HSBC, bravely joined the Hong Kong Volunteer Defence Force with no military training and was thrown into a deadly battle to defend the island. Rylance's views on war are tested as he uncovers the real and shocking story of how Osmond survived Hong Kong's notorious POW camps.
programme.title: My Grandparents' War

Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael shows us how to make an impossibly delicious brunch menu of Parm Frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that you can serve all day.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Asian chef Kinsan and Laura make Japanese Vegetable Tempura in the Market Kitchen. Laura then prepares Chicken Schnitzel with Mushroom Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Come spring, Lidia gets very excited to visit the market. The colour, the aromas, that first harvest, it all ignites her creative side to get cooking after a long winter.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden dives at sunrise for sea urchins, then he's off to a local farmers' market to buy mushrooms, grab some famous donuts, and cook for his friends on their goat farm.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: Hot and spicy is all the rage in today's episode. Rebecca Veale is back in the kitchen for crispy chilli stir fry, and Simon brings a spicy salad loaded with mouthwatering roasted radishes.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver arrives on the tiny Sicilian island of Marettimo. Here he meets fisherman Giovanni - the owner of one of Sicily's best restaurants - who has Jamie work as his assistant in his eatery.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a beautifully buttery night on The Cook Up, as Adam is joined by croissant connoisseur Kate Reid and acclaimed chef Giovanni Pilu.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: This traditional Tuscan dish is perfect for a summer's late lunch to carry you into an evening of relaxing. Michael Symon revamps some grilled chicken by glazing it with some floral vermouth.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula shows us how to make her version of steak diane by substituting the steak with a collop of venision which she roasts and serves with sauteed potatoes. She demonstrates how to smoke a chicken.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Chef Luke Nguyen visits the beachside town of Nha Trang, a coastal town abundant with fresh seafood - and prepares char grilled lobster right on the beach.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke heads to a coastal town to teach cooking skills to disabled children, who learn how to prepare fish cakes; Luke visits to a farmyard to learn how a family creates fresh tofu; local monks demonstrate how to cook a vegetarian meal.

programme.title: Planet Bbq
programme.desc: This show gives grilled and smoked vegetables their due; tandoori cauliflower with coriander mint chutney, squash gratin with habanero chiles, and Mexican pit-roasted lamb.

programme.title: Fun'q With Spencer Watts
programme.desc: The sun is shining and Spencer is turning up the heat, cooking delicious grilled food perfect to be served on a bun. He shares his secrets to the perfect grilled veggie burger and sesame meatloaf.

programme.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
programme.desc: Nornie journeys to Hammond Island to explore its unique blend of cultures and rich history.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Grown Up Tomato Soup And Grilled Cheese
programme.desc: This classic combo from your youth gets an adult makeover and will make your mouth water. Rachael shows us her version of a creamy tomato soup and a spicy grilled cheese.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
